name: addCategoryToQuadrant
shortDescription: Associates a predefined category (e.g., Vendors, Locations) with a specific Quadrant for detailed organization.
description:
Overview

Creates a QuadrantCategory record to link a Category to a Quadrant within a Molecule, providing contextual grouping for tasks and deliverables.

Intended use

Called by the Lead Point persona from the Quadrant and Participant Detail View UI to refine the organization of a quadrant. Parameters include quadrantId, categoryId, and moleculeId.

Logic

  1. Validate that params.quadrantId exists by querying the Quadrant entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  2. Validate that params.categoryId exists by querying the Category entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  3. Validate that params.moleculeId exists by querying the Molecule entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  4. Check if a QuadrantCategory record already exists for the given quadrantId and categoryId using ctx.data.query. If it does, return a conflict error or the existing record.
  5. Create a new QuadrantCategory record using ctx.data.create with quadrantId, categoryId, moleculeId, and assignedByUserId (from ctx.user_id).
  6. Audit-log the association using ctx.audit.log, including the quadrant and category IDs.
  7. Return the created QuadrantCategory record.

Entities

  • QuadrantCategory
  • Quadrant
  • Category
  • Molecule
